caption:
Fine yesterday, sore again today. How do you know you're actually getting better?

At Hybrid Physio we start with your goals, like running 10 km or sitting through a meeting. Then your practitioner may measure strength, range of movement, balance or reps, and repeat the same tests every few weeks to show real change. For some problems, a short questionnaire helps too.

Pain can go up and down day to day, so sleep, work, exercise and confidence all count. If progress stalls, we review the plan with you, adjust exercises or load, or refer you back to your GP.

Our physios, chiropractors, Pilates team and remedial massage therapists check in on your goals regularly. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
